title: missing smartwatch sensor data
body:
Hi,

since release 12th of June I no longer get any smartwatch sensor data (heartrate, pace) displayed in xdrip.
I've checked settings (settings -> smartwatch sensor -> use health data (=on) and heart rate sensor (=on) but the graphs and the counters never get displayed or updated.
Watch is Huawei Watch 2, the huawei health app is getting the data without any interruptions.
So what could be wrong?

comments.body:
Well, figured it out:
I had to give google fit the permissions to read and use the sensor data..
